name: VaultSparkStudios.github.io
currentFocus: S317 restored The Desk reader loop end to end. The reaction failure was a release-lane shape, not a client bug: the content lane promotes hash-named client assets but hard-blocks cloudflare/**, so it shipped the caller and stranded the callee. Deployed via the identity lane, corrected a provenance receipt that was laundering the missing routes as a bot challenge, replaced mis-derived story labels with reader-facing ones, and shipped per-article reach, engaged time, attention ratio and away-time bands — all server-rendered and floor-suppressed.
publicNote: Reader reactions work on The Desk again, and every article now shows how many pageloads it drew, how long readers actually spent reading, and how much of the estimated read that represents — with each figure withheld until enough readers have arrived to make it mean something.
nextMilestone: Confirm the new Desk surfaces cross their publish floors on real traffic and observe the first end-to-end idle-band row, then complete the Reader-signal to Director’s Report closure now that the rollup exists. Do not lower a floor to make a page look alive.
